facts.fact: Ouragan.cd, AfricaNews and Alternance.cd say article 13 of DRC telecommunications law no. 20/017 of 25 November 2020 assigns the regulator ARPTC the regulation and control of personal data protection; the article does not say the ARPTC does this work.

systems.system: Autorite de regulation de la poste et des telecommunications du Congo (ARPTC)
Autorite de regulation de la poste et des telecommunications du Congo (ARPTC)

COD.note: Article names the regulator's data protection mission under the telecommunications law but states no data protection law, appointment of an authority or action by it.
